mcp:tool-listener.name: find_properties
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: find_properties - Tool Listener
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Return Ascott properties in a resolved country/city matching all supplied search filters. Use for property discovery and browsing. countryCode or city is required.

mcp:text-tool-response-content.text: #[write({code:(error.errorType.identifier default "INTERNAL_ERROR"),message:(error.description default "Unable to retrieve property results."),correlationId:(vars.correlationId default correlationId),timestamp:now() as String {format:"yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"}},"application/json")]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn="everywhere" --- vars.toolRequest ++ { noOfadults: (vars.toolRequest.noOfadults default 1) as Number, noOfchildren: (vars.toolRequest.noOfchildren default 0) as Number, noOfRooms: (vars.toolRequest.noOfRooms default 1) as Number, //isLongStay: (vars.toolRequest.isLongStay default false) as Boolean, country: (payload.countryCode default "SG") as String, currency: (payload.curreny default "SGD") as String }
